item.title: President Evil #4
item.description: Yes We Cannibal Washington, D.C. is now completely overrun with the undead. While it’s an option he never wanted to employ, ‘Ba-rot’ has no choice but to wall up the zombie-infested city! The embattled President then makes his way to the nation’s new capital in…Honolulu!?
